lines.zh: 我迈着短腿，在院子里走。
lines.en: I walk the yard on short legs.

lines.zh: 我一步一点头，像在啄地。
lines.en: I bob my head with each step.

lines.zh: 我展开尾羽，走得更神气。
lines.en: I fan my tail and strut.
I circle the haystack once.
I squeeze through a fence gap.

lines.zh: 我在泥地上踩出一串印。
lines.en: I leave a line of prints in the mud.
I walk slowly to the trough.

lines.zh: 我追着一只小虫跑了几步。
lines.en: I chase a bug a few steps.
I sway through the vegetable patch.
I stop and shake my feathers.
I circle my fellow once.
I head for the light at the gate.
I step in soft soil and sink a little.
Heavy with flesh, I walk ponderously.
I walk back into the shade.
Fattened up. Can't walk fast.
I stand with my tail slightly fanned.
I dip my head and peck the ground.
I puff out my flesh.
I listen to the yard.

lines.zh: 我转过那颗小脑袋，看你。
lines.en: I turn my small head to look at you.

lines.zh: 我的叫声从谷仓这头传到那头。
lines.en: My call carries from one end of the barn to the other.
I rest in the shade.
The wind spreads my tail feathers.
I'm so fat I walk slowly.
Nothing much is happening.

lines.zh: 我抖松胸羽，露出发红的肉垂。
lines.en: I fluff my breast feathers, baring my red wattle.

lines.zh: 我低下头，看看自己的影子。
lines.en: I look down at my shadow.
The sun is good; I'm content.

lines.zh: 我换了个朝向，尾羽对着太阳。
lines.en: I turn about, tail feathers toward the sun.
I settle down a little.
I rise again and stand tall.
Stand back and let me look at you.
I've spread my whole tail.
I puff myself up at you.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，头一伸一缩。
lines.en: I stare at your hand, head thrusting and withdrawing.
Fattened up, even my neck feels heavy.

lines.zh: 我这身羽毛不是白长的。
lines.en: These feathers aren't for nothing.
I take two steps and stop.
Your steps are too hurried.
I gobble once as a greeting.
Fed fat, that is when the meat is plenty.
No wandering about this yard.
I move slowly toward you.

lines.zh: 我连跑带跳，钻进草丛里。
lines.en: I run and hop into the tall grass.
A small handful of feathers came out.
I puff up and back away.

lines.zh: 我扑棱两下，羽毛落了满地。
lines.en: I flap twice, feathers scattering everywhere.
I stagger two steps and straighten.
I hide behind the haystack.

lines.zh: 我抖开羽毛，血珠甩在地上。
lines.en: I shake my feathers, flinging drops of blood.

lines.zh: 我趴了一下，用翅膀撑着起身。
lines.en: I slump, then push myself up with a wing.

lines.zh: 羽毛掉了两根，我跑得歪歪扭扭。
lines.en: Two feathers fall, and I run crooked.
I retreat slowly to the fence.
Is that wheat? Let me see.

lines.zh: 我一摇一摆，朝你的手跑来。
lines.en: I waddle toward your hand at a run.
I know that smell; it's grain.
I peck once; it's good.
Feed me a little at a time.
I look up at you between bites.
Two bites and it's gone.

lines.zh: 我盯着你手里的麦穗，不眨眼。
lines.en: I stare at the wheat in your hand without blinking.
Once full, I stand still.
I could take a little more.

lines.zh: 你撒下来的，我一粒粒啄。
lines.en: I peck up each grain you scatter.
This wheat chews nicely.
Halfway through, I look up at you.
Steady your hand or the grain spills.
When full, I'll wander off.
This taste reminds me of autumn.

lines.zh: 我撞回来，胸口的肥肉晃了晃。
lines.en: I bump back, the fat on my chest wobbling.

lines.zh: 我这身肉，站着就占地方。
lines.en: All this flesh takes up space.

lines.zh: 我的肉垂晃了晃，往旁边挪。
lines.en: My wattle wobbles as I shuffle aside.
I puff up to startle you.

lines.zh: 我挪开半步，尾羽扫过地面。
lines.en: I shift half a step, tail feathers brushing the ground.
The fence gap is too narrow.
My tail feathers got knocked askew.
I hold my balance and don't topple.
A layer of dust rises.

lines.zh: 我被撞得晃了晃，肥身子稳住。
lines.en: The bump rocks me, and my heavy body settles.
Another one is in the yard too.
I fan my tail to its fullest.
I strut in circles around her.
She dips her head; that's a yes.
Behind the haystack is private.
This clutch must be well guarded.
We dip our heads and feed together.

lines.zh: 太阳落下去，我们靠得近。
lines.en: The sun sets; we stand close.
I shake my feathers, content.
Tomorrow I'll still be in this yard.
I peck it up and shake it twice.

lines.zh: 我啄起一粒石子，又吐出来。
lines.en: I pick up a pebble and spit it out.
Too hard; I can't break it.

lines.zh: 我仰头一吞，玉米粒没了。
lines.en: I tip my head back, and the kernel is gone.

lines.zh: 我用喙拨开谷壳，找底下的粒。
lines.en: I push the husks aside to find the grain beneath.
I scratch at it with a claw.

lines.zh: 我含着一粒玉米，咕咕叫。
lines.en: I hold a kernel of corn in my bill and gobble.
I drop it and keep looking.
It's much bigger than a grain.

lines.zh: 我叼着那片菜叶，到处炫耀。
lines.en: I carry the leaf around, showing it off.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，朝谷粒的方向看。
lines.en: I raise my head toward the scattered grain.
I see a bug on the ground.
I strut that way.
That's grain, not a stone.
Fattened twice, my meat runs thicker.
I lower my head to look closer.

lines.zh: 我低头啄，一下一下，很有节奏。
lines.en: I peck, one stroke after another, in rhythm.
It's not far.

lines.zh: 喂我两次小麦，我就更肥。
lines.en: Two rounds of wheat and I'm fatter.
I'll go round to have a look.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，肉垂就晃一下。
lines.en: With every step, my wattle swings.
I bob my head as I walk.
I've grown fat, so I run slowly.
I take two steps nearer.

lines.zh: 我脖子伸得老长，羽毛全竖起来。
lines.en: My neck stretches out, feathers all standing up.

lines.zh: 我张开尾羽，影子铺在地上。
lines.en: I spread my tail, and my shadow covers the ground.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子，一步一步靠近。
lines.en: I stretch my neck and close in step by step.
I pause, then peck.

lines.zh: 喂我两次小麦，肉就更多。
lines.en: Feed me wheat twice and there's more meat.

lines.zh: 我的尾羽张开，喉咙鼓起来。
lines.en: My tail fans out, and my throat swells.
I give a sharp peck.
Claws scratch the soil for seeds.

lines.zh: 我张开翅，扑打着撞过去。
lines.en: I spread my wings and beat my way into you.

lines.zh: 胖身子撞上去，羽毛先飞了。
lines.en: My fat body hits and feathers fly first.
I puff myself up huge.
I pin it under a claw.
I raise my head and look about.
I withdraw to the haystack.

lines.zh: 我用翅根撞它，像一记闷拳。
lines.en: I hit it with the base of my wing like a dull punch.
I shove forward, solidly.

lines.zh: 麦子喂了两回，我走不快。
lines.en: Fed wheat twice, and I cannot walk fast.
I shake my feathers and stand tall.
A turkey, standing mid-yard.

lines.zh: 我把尾羽张开，占了半片地。
lines.en: I fan my tail and fill half the yard.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走出来，一步一顿。
lines.en: I step out slowly, pausing each step.

lines.zh: 我从草垛后走出来，边叫边张尾。
lines.en: I step from behind the haystack, calling and fanning my tail.
I squeeze through from beyond the fence.

lines.zh: 我把脖子伸长，四下张望。
lines.en: I stretch my neck and look around.
The yard is quiet today.
I head for the trough.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛被燎得卷起来了。
lines.en: My feathers curl from the flames.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下来，翻了个身。
lines.en: I fall from a height and roll over.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的羽毛，动不了。
lines.en: Water soaks my feathers and I can't move.

lines.zh: 爆响把我掀得滚了两圈。
lines.en: The blast rolls me twice.
An arrow pinned the base of my wing.

lines.zh: 紫光扫过，我的腿软了一下。
lines.en: Violet light sweeps past, and my legs buckle.

lines.zh: 我饿得只剩羽毛和骨头。
lines.en: Hunger has left me nothing but feathers and bone.
At the thunder, I tuck my neck in.
There's no ground to tread here.
